content.short: Mockthereum is a library that simulates the Ethereum development environment with mock nodes.
content.description: Mockthereum is a tool within the HTTP toolkit for rapid testing, development, and debugging on the Ethereum Virtual Machine. It enables you to spin up fake Ethereum nodes, deploy your code onto them, and exercise every transaction routed through the node. You can tailor a node by adjusting its parameters to reproduce a variety of network scenarios on the Ethereum network, including both standard operations and malicious conditions. This setup supports thorough validation of contracts and tooling in isolated environments prior to live deployment.
